title: Gas Lamps in Berlin - Quick Summary
kicker: WALK OF BERLIN • LIVING IN BERLIN
items: **16,332 gas lamps** are still in Berlin's lighting register (checked 10 November 2026), down from about 44,000 before the conversion began.
**About 95 per cent stand in the former West.** Pankow and Lichtenberg have none in the register.
**Only about 3,300 are meant to stay on gas,** inside protected areas agreed in 2013. The rest have no such decision.
**There is no end date.** Lamps are converted as the budget allows, at about 10,000 euro each.
**Even the protected areas are under review:** the Senate asked the heritage office in 2025 to look at them again.
**From space the old border still shows:** orange sodium light in the East, whiter light in the West.
**Type your street into the map** to see your lamps, their type and whether they sit in a protected area.
